description: Answer a pending request of a browser task. For a question pass answer; for an approval pass decision approve or deny. An approval applies only to the exact previewed action: the task must retry the same batch, and any change needs a new approval. Only call this with the user's own reply. Approvals and standing permissions are the user's own consent: this agent connection cannot approve them (403 approver_required). The user approves in their AlterLab dashboard (or the AlterLab Connect extension, which approves through the user's own signed-in session); the agent then retries the same batch.
name: alterlab_hands_answer
title: Answer Agent Request
